title: 'Endgame' dethrones 'Avatar' as highest-grossing film of all time
description: Avengers: Endgame has reclaimed its position as the highest-grossing film following a re-release. The film surpassed Avatar's total box office earnings by a narrow margin after its Encore re-release. Despite a drop to seventh place domestically, additional earnings helped Endgame regain the crown. Marvel Studios expressed gratitude to fans for their support through social media messages. The success of Endgame coincides with anticipation for the upcoming film Avengers: Doomsday.

title: Tom Cruise's 'Digger' FLOPS; 'Verity' tops box office
description: Warner Bros.' film 'Digger' failed to perform at the box office during its opening weekend. The film grossed only $8 million domestically against a production budget of $125 to $150 million. Meanwhile, Amazon MGM's 'Verity' topped the charts, earning $32.6 million in its debut weekend. This disappointing performance occurs as Warner Bros. faces a merger with Paramount Skydance.

title: Janhvi CONDEMNS AI-altered 'Chuttamalle' clip as 'deeply violating, bordering on sexual assault'
description: Janhvi Kapoor has strongly criticized a viral AI-manipulated video of her from the track 'Chuttamalle,' deeming it a serious infringement. She raised concerns about the exploitation of technology to objectify women, stressing the importance of consent. Supporting her, Jr NTR, her co-star from 'Devara,' condemned the video as well and indicated potential legal action. Read on to know more in detail.

title: Motivational quote of the day by Jack Black
description: Jack Black passionately champions the idea that failure is a vital stepping stone toward growth in both personal and professional realms. He emphasizes that the anxiety surrounding failure often stops individuals from pursuing new opportunities. Sharing his own adventures filled with setbacks, Black inspires others to embrace learning and adaptability. His message ultimately celebrates resilience as a transformative force amidst life's challenges.

title: 'Drishyam 3' director's wife's note for him: 'I teared up'
description: In a touching tribute, Shivaleeka Oberoi celebrated her husband Abhishek Pathak's accomplishment with the film 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion'. Her pride was evident as she highlighted his relentless efforts and the film's warm reception. The crime thriller, focusing on the Salgaonkar family's new dilemmas, earned over Rs 168 crore in its opening weekend. Oberoi expressed her eagerness for their daughter Aarika to witness her father's remarkable journey.

title: Drishyam 3 The Conclusion's worldwide tally crosses Rs 272 crore in 3 days
description: Ajay Devgn-led ‘Drishyam 3 The Conclusion’ has maintained strong momentum at the box office as it enters its third day in theatres. The crime thriller opened with Rs 62 crore net in India on Day 1 and followed it with another Rs 53.50 crore on Day 2. The film has already crossed Rs 125 crore in India net and is now approaching another major domestic milestone. The immediate target is the Rs 150 crore India net mark. The franchise's established audience base, holiday release window and strong advance momentum give the film a solid foundation, but its long-term performance will ultimately depend on audience response and weekday stability.

title: When Zeenat Aman shared a brutally honest take on fame: 'One day you're loved'
description: In a candid chat with Karan Johar, Zeenat Aman reflected on her journey through fame, emphasizing that it is both volatile and not indicative of personal value. She pointed out how public opinion can swing dramatically over time. Having enjoyed stardom since the early 1970s, she also touched upon the complexities of her two marriages and the lessons learned through them.

title: MS Dhoni meets Nitin Mukesh and his family; veteran singer says he is 'Thala' for a reason

title: 'Hanuman Ansh' BO Day 59: Worldwide gross soars Rs 423 crore
description: ‘Hanuman Ansh’ continues its remarkable theatrical run even as it enters Day 59. The Vishal Chaturvedi directorial has maintained its momentum well beyond the usual lifespan of a theatrical release, with the Neem Karoli Baba biopic now firmly into its ninth week. According to Sacnilk, the film's India net total stood at Rs. 321.73 crore and gross collection to Rs. 379.96 crore by the end of Day 58.The Day 59 figure is still live and the final tally is expected to change once all shows are accounted for.

title: Quote of the day by Cher
description: Cher faced numerous challenges in her early life, including a troubled childhood and career setbacks. After dropping out of school, she moved to Los Angeles to pursue her dreams. Despite being written off multiple times, she reinvented herself and achieved remarkable success as an actress and musician. Her iconic quote encourages others to never give up on their dreams, regardless of time constraints.

title: In 2026, Verity’s real-life home is a striking 1960s New York residence
description: Located in Armonk, New York, Beckoning Path stands as the striking filming location for Verity. This midcentury-modern masterpiece, designed by Jens Quistgaard, boasts unique elements that deepen the film's haunting tone. Although key scenes were filmed at the actual home, many were recreated on soundstages. The interior underwent a transformative redesign to underscore the unsettling themes of familial discord portrayed in the film.

title: Jackie Shroff says NOBODY wanted Chunnilal role in 'Devdas'
description: Jackie Shroff opened up about landing the role of Chunnilal in the cinematic masterpiece 'Devdas.' He explained how reluctance from other actors, who feared overshadowing Shah Rukh Khan's Devdas, cleared the way for him. Shroff appreciated the chance to connect with Madhuri Dixit's Chandramukhi character, demonstrating his readiness to embrace diverse roles, even with limited dialogue.

title: Tamannaah reveals taking deep-sea diving lessons for terrifying underwater The Vvaan scene

The actor underwent swimming and deep-sea diving classes before shooting the near-drowning scene and credited co-star Sidharth Malhotra, a deep-sea diver, for supporting her. Tamannaah also dismissed rumours of a rift around the film and said its success has given her “more than my due” as an actor.

title: In 2021, Diane Keaton bought a Laguna Beach home for $6.6 million

Now back on the market for $10.3 million, the new owners have preserved her design choices, embodying Keaton's celebrated love for architecture and home renovations.
